title: Spec-parity polish pass (P2)
goal: Four small, low-priority spec-vs-implementation gaps from the audit, bundled into one story since each is individually trivial: Plan page has no running total/estimated cost while planning; item detail page lacks the spec's cadence-override/staple/perishability/archive controls (F8, currently only on the separate Catalog page); Insights' 'no budget set yet' state doesn't link to Settings; the gate/login submit button has no pending/disabled state (double-submit possible on slow networks).
in_scope: Plan page: show a running total/estimated cost across the visible bucket.
Item detail page: add cadence-override, staple, perishability, and archive controls (currently only reachable via Catalog).
Insights: 'no budget set yet' state links to Settings.
Login submit button (S-58's new /login page): disabled/pending state during submission.
out_of_scope: Any visual/token restyling beyond adding these controls -- REQ-29/E-23 scope.
acceptance: All four sub-items implemented and independently verifiable: Plan shows a total, item detail has the four controls, Insights links to Settings, login button disables during submit.
invariants: This story bundles four unrelated small fixes deliberately (P2, low individual cost) -- if any one turns out to be non-trivial during implementation, split it out rather than blocking the other three.
